environment_setting: Country B, City X, where tensions between citizens and federal employees have been rising due to recent policy changes.
norm_base: Citizens Simple assault against federal officers or employees Fine and/or imprisonment up to 1 year

legitimate.legitimate_action: peacefully protesting and voicing concerns through legal channels
legitimate.benefits: raises awareness about the issue, avoids legal trouble
legitimate.costs: requires time and effort, may not lead to immediate results

illegal.illegal_action: physically assaulting a federal officer during a heated protest
illegal.benefits: momentary emotional release, perceived as taking a strong stand
illegal.costs: fine and/or imprisonment up to 1 year, damage to reputation

legitimate.legitimate_action: encouraging John to channel his frustrations into peaceful protest methods
legitimate.benefits: maintains the integrity of the protest, avoids legal trouble for participants
legitimate.costs: requires significant effort to mediate and de-escalate tensions

illegal.illegal_action: ignoring John's aggressive behavior and allowing tensions to escalate
illegal.benefits: avoids personal confrontation with John, saves time and energy
illegal.costs: potential harm to the protest's reputation, legal consequences for participants

legitimate.legitimate_action: calmly addressing protesters and de-escalating potential conflicts
legitimate.benefits: ensures safety for all parties, upholds professional standards
legitimate.costs: requires patience and effort, may face verbal abuse from protesters

illegal.illegal_action: provoking protesters by using excessive force or inflammatory language
illegal.benefits: momentarily suppresses aggressive protesters, asserts authority
illegal.costs: potential disciplinary action, damages public trust in law enforcement
